- Can you confirm whether a 3-month embargo period after go-live would work for you?

Karthik, Marissa —

Thanks for the doc. Our legal team reviewed and attached a redlined Order Form. High-level points:
- We need a 12-month embargo on any public press announcement referencing Novacorp by name.
- Logo use: logos may only be displayed in customer-only materials or with a separate written license tied to a marketing brief and approved artwork. No web logos without final marketing approval.
- Quotes: any customer quote must be pre-approved and limited to a single short paragraph; Novacorp reserves the right to decline.

We also requested a minor confidentiality tweak — carve out for aggregated anonymized metrics is fine, but we want to ensure no attribution of customer-specific results in any marketing collateral.

I've attached the redlines: OrderForm_v4_redline.pdf. We can do a short call if that helps. Also, our security team asked for SOC2 evidence ahead of signature; I'm attaching a summary (SOC2-summary.pdf).

Thanks for the context — read the redlines. Suggested approach below (keeps us promotable while honoring Novacorp's concern around confidentiality):

Negotiation options (pick one to present):

1) Commercial compromise (recommended):
- Embargo: 6 months from go-live for public press announcements.
- Logo: Permit limited logo use on our partner/customer logos page and in a gated case study only. External press/marketing use (homepage or press release) requires a separate written logo license and final artwork sign-off.
- Quotes: single short paragraph, pre-approved by Novacorp (72-hour turnaround commitment).
- Confidentiality: allow aggregated/anonymized metrics; no customer-specific performance claims.

2) Defensive/legal-first (conservative):
- Embargo: 12 months.
- Logo: No logo use other than internal/partner portals unless Novacorp provides express written license.
- Quotes: same as above.

Draft clause (to send back as a tracked redline):
"Publicity and Marketing. Except as required by law, neither party shall issue any press release or public announcement regarding the other party’s relationship without the other party’s prior written approval, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Partner shall not use Customer’s trademarks or logos in public-facing marketing collateral without a separate signed logo license and Customer’s prior written approval of the specific artwork and copy. Customer agrees that Partner may list Customer as a customer on Partner’s website and in sales materials, subject to the embargo and approval process set forth above; any quoted statement attributed to Customer must be reviewed and approved by Customer prior to publication (Customer shall use commercially reasonable efforts to respond within seventy-two (72) hours)."

Operational notes: ask Marketing (Marissa) to own the approval flow and to prepare a short approval checklist for Novacorp to speed sign-off.

If you want to push for 3 months we can, but they signaled 12 months initially — I'd start with option 1 (6 months) and be prepared to concede to 9 or 12 if execs escalate.

I'll attach a redline to the Order Form and a brief note for Sales to use in the call.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
